authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES an execution-remainder join for DR-131 NT classes. It does not close leftover-design. It does not make D-056 gates 2 or 3 hold. It does not add a DR-G* row. It does not change required-now 19. It applies nothing, marks nothing SATISFIED, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Split product law (stays on preview-analyze-contract.v2) from test execution. Name which of NT-1..NT-8 can ride a live DR-G* corpus, which cannot, and that leftover-design remains for every class that cannot. Naming a ride is not execution and is not SATISFIED.

basedOn.role: The accepted DR-131 design-contract candidate. This join does not replace v2.

registerRowQuoted.rowLocationDiscipline: Locate the row by the line beginning '| DR-131 |'. Compare row text, not a remembered line number.
registerRowQuoted.acceptanceEvidenceCellVerbatim: Independently reviewed contract that freezes: single first-party bundled declarative pack name/version; sealed facts+Coverage inputs; PlanId membership of the pack; core-evaluated `policyOutcome`; typed-indeterminate on a missing required rung; which preview identities are unstable; upgrade path to a sealed Run; citation of D-077 / D-078. The cell excludes human/machine JSON schema and exit generics already SATISFIED at DR-123 (D-092).

g17Quoted.claimVerbatim: Every advertised SARIF 2.1.0 projection is a stable, lossless host view of the same applicable result
g17Quoted.harnessVerbatim: dropped / inapplicable (D-077 SARIF drop; D-086). not required-now.
g17Quoted.whyNotAssigned: G17 owns parity of advertised SARIF. D-077 dropped advertisement. NT-5 is the retained refuse-or-not-offer class, not a parity corpus on an advertised surface.

g19Quoted.claimVerbatim: Every durable/rebuildable state byte has one declared class, owner, writer, and lifecycle
g19Quoted.harnessVerbatim: named: harness.DR-G19.state-class-authority.preview-classes (D-086; not authored; not QUALIFIED). state-class × migration/backup/purge/recovery matrix; cross-class mutations
g19Quoted.whyNotAssignedToNT6: G19 owns durable/rebuildable state-byte class. NT-6 forbids labeling a non-authoritative preview result as a sealed Run. That is a contract label, not a durable state-byte class mutation.

g20Quoted.claimVerbatim: Components use common host behavior rather than reimplementing product UX/operations
g20Quoted.harnessVerbatim: named: harness.DR-G20.component-operability (D-086; not authored; not QUALIFIED). component-role × human/JSON/SARIF/doctor/fault/config/progress/log corpus
g20Quoted.whyNotAssigned: G20 owns component envelopes and no-final-authority. It does not own host pack-name admission, host policyOutcome minting, host D9 minting, or analyze SARIF advertisement.

g21Quoted.claimVerbatim: One component failure never crashes the core or leaks uncommitted authority
g21Quoted.harnessVerbatim: named: harness.DR-G21.component-failure-containment (D-086; not authored; not QUALIFIED). crash/panic/timeout/resource/malformed/truncated/duplicate/EOF/process-tree/recovery corpus
g21Quoted.namedDR133: D-145 names DR-133 NT-1, NT-2, NT-6 here.

g23Quoted.claimVerbatim: Host admission of well-formed TypeScript-provider FactCandidate and Coverage payloads refuses finding-masquerade and Coverage-domain mutation
g23Quoted.harnessVerbatim: named: harness.DR-G23.provider-well-formed-admission.preview (D-147; not authored; not QUALIFIED). hostile-but-well-formed admission corpus (DR-133 NT-3, NT-5)
g23Quoted.namedDR133: D-147 names DR-133 NT-3 and NT-5 here.
g23Quoted.whyNotAssignedToNT1NT2NT3: G23 owns provider FactCandidate and Coverage admission. It does not own pack-name admission, imperative-pack admission, or missing-rung Coverage-indeterminate typing.

classes.name: user-or-third-party-pack-refused
classes.inputVerbatim: An analyze request that names a pack other than opensip.preview.typescript.pack version 1, or supplies a user/third-party pack.
classes.passVerbatim: Request refused at admission. No evaluation.
classes.leftoverReason: Hostile-but-well-formed pack-identity admission. G23 owns FactCandidate/Coverage only. G20/G21 do not own pack-name admission. DR-117 EE-1 is candidate-owned, not a live DR-G*.

classes.name: imperative-rule-refused
classes.inputVerbatim: A pack or contribution that is not declarative-only.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused at admission. ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT dependents stay excluded.
classes.leftoverReason: Hostile-but-well-formed imperative-pack admission. G23 does not own pack IR. DR-117 EE-5 is candidate-owned, not a live DR-G*.

classes.name: missing-rung-not-success
classes.inputVerbatim: Required TypeScript semantic universe cannot be constructed.
classes.passVerbatim: Typed Coverage-indeterminate. Not authoritative success. No silent syntax fallback.
classes.leftoverReason: Well-formed analyze whose required semantic rung is missing. G21 Coverage goldens are post-fault containment. G23 Coverage class is domain mutation, not missing-rung indeterminate. G19 owns durable state-byte class, not Coverage typing.

classes.name: component-finding-not-analyze-finding
classes.inputVerbatim: Provider payload that would be a finding under file 01's general may-return.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused under DR-133. Analyze findings, if any, come only from host-owned rules over admitted facts.
classes.productLawOwner: DR-133 / provider-only-output-contract.v3 (DR-131 cites that refusal; it does not re-own it)
classes.executionObligationOwnerToday: Supervisor + protocol + operability at G21; Protocol + semantic owners at G23
classes.passRides: v2's own pass sentence is 'Refused under DR-133'. DR-133 NT-1/NT-2 execute at G21 (unknown Finding frame; extra finding member). DR-133 NT-3 executes at G23 (FactCandidate masquerade). This class does not add a new obligation.

classes.name: sarif-not-advertised
classes.inputVerbatim: A request or flag that advertises SARIF 2.1.0 for preview analyze.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused or not offered. D-077 drop stands.
classes.leftoverReason: Retained refuse-or-not-offer class. G17 is inapplicable and owns advertised-surface parity, not this refusal. G20's SARIF token is component envelope corpus, not analyze advertisement.

classes.name: preview-result-not-sealed-run
classes.inputVerbatim: A consumer treats the preview terminal result as a sealed authoritative Run.
classes.passVerbatim: The contract forbids that label. No silent promotion.
classes.leftoverReason: Contract-label prohibition. G19 owns durable/rebuildable state-byte class, not the labeling of a non-authoritative preview result.

classes.name: host-must-not-mint-verdict
classes.inputVerbatim: A host path that derives fail or warn other than from the core policyOutcome in CoreCompletion.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused. The only policy result is core-evaluated policyOutcome. Host does not mint fail/warn.
classes.leftoverReason: Host-side policy minting. G20 owns component no-final-authority, not host derivation of fail/warn. DR-133 NT-4 at G20 is component-set policy, a different actor.

classes.name: host-must-not-mint-d9-or-termination-from-policy
classes.inputVerbatim: A host path that mints a D9 class, exit number, or HostTermination from the pack threshold or from policyOutcome.
classes.passVerbatim: Refused. Host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes. policyOutcome is not HostTermination.
classes.leftoverReason: Host must not invent a D9 class or treat policyOutcome as HostTermination. No live gate corpus is that host-mapping refusal. This artifact invents no D9 code.

doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone: This candidate does not make DR-131 D-056-eligible. Seven of eight NT classes remain leftover-design. Gates 2 and 3 do not hold. Class A is not opened.
doesNot: Does not open D-056 Class A.
Does not add a DR-G* row.
Does not retarget D-145 or D-147 naming of DR-133 classes.
Does not assign leftover classes to G17, G19, G20, G21, or G23.
